changed: The chat surface gap audit after 4b (docs/reviews/2026-10-21-chat-surface-gap-audit.md) scored 88 items: 56 met, 25 partial, 4 missing, 3 not applicable. Its 19 findings are 6 High, 6 Medium and 7 Low. The High ones: F-1, no AI disclosure outside Overview; F-2, no thread; F-3, no closable workspace (EA-10); F-4, the agent's answer is unlabelled; F-5, card terms scroll with no cue; F-6, no citations. The design brief research/20-conversation-thread-brief.md covers all ten normative states, the AG and EA-1/3/5/6/9/10/16 criteria, three directions, the D15 surfaces (the card is unchanged, as ADR 0034 §5 is deferred), the 'grounded, not verified' wording, and the questions for G-B. G-B (2026-10-21) was owner-delegated; the owner wrote verbatim: "advisor can decide all on behalf me". The advisor decided: 1 A (run cards with a closable side workspace); 2 group (legacy runs under 'last seen'); 3 refuse (an answer to an ended run gets CONFLICT 'the question changed; read it again', draft kept; amends ADR 0023 §4 through new task 4d.6); 4 hint (open composer, server hint, draft kept, card unchanged); 5 both (label on the message and the result); 6 auto (the desktop workspace opens itself and is closable); 7 accept (new VI drafts, flagged at G-D as 'new VI since G-B'); 8 yes (a grounded-not-verified state in the UX standard, as a separate skill follow-up that also moves EA-10's source to ADR 0034). research/** is create-only, so this record lives in the plan's 4e.1 line and in this handoff, not in the brief. Commits a720c991, 62a29b83 and the plan record. Review harness/state/4/reviews/4e.1.json (rework) was fixed by the coordinator: the 4d.6 check order and retried-answer test (U1-1), the wording (U1-3), the audit line reference (U1-5) and the deferred index line (U1-6).
